description: The misses feature folder (repo + tools), MCP registration, and review integration. Creates src/features/misses/ with misses.repo.ts and misses.tools.ts, registers mark_missed and mark_event_missed in the Coaching area, and adds missed records to the weekly/monthly review digest. Depends on FEAT-001 (DB) and FEAT-002 (XP engine).
steps: Create /home/kingsleydaprime/code/personal/mypaddie/src/features/misses/misses.repo.ts.
Import: missedXp from @/features/xp/xp; currentConfig from @/shared/config; Db from @/shared/supabase/token-client.
Internal helper loadTaskForMiss(db, taskId): queries tasks with task_pillars, returns {id, title, baseXp, weights} or null.

Internal helper loadEventForMiss(db, eventId): queries events, returns {id, title, baseXp: 10} (events don't have base_xp; use 10 as the default) or null. Note: if events table has no base_xp column use a hardcoded default of 10 — record this in findings.

Export async function markTaskMissed(db: Db, taskId: string, reason: string, now: Date). Loads task, computes missedXp(task.baseXp, task.weights, true, config), calls db.rpc('record_miss', {p_task_id: taskId, p_event_id: null, p_reason: reason, p_penalty_entries: penaltyEntries, p_honesty_entries: honestyEntries, p_self_reported: true}), returns {result, title, xpLost, honestyEarned}.
Export async function markEventMissed(db: Db, eventId: string, reason: string, now: Date). Same pattern but for events.
Separate penalty/honesty entries: penalty = entries with reason 'miss_penalty', honesty = entries with reason 'honesty_bonus'. Pass as separate jsonb params to record_miss.
Create /home/kingsleydaprime/code/personal/mypaddie/src/features/misses/misses.tools.ts.

Register mark_missed tool: inputSchema = {task_id: z.uuid(), reason: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300).describe('What got in the way or why it was missed, in their words')}. Description (verbatim): 'Record that something didn\'t happen and the user is owning up to it. Different from log_slip, which is skipping with a reason that Paddie judges: mark_missed means it didn\'t happen, no excuse, honest acknowledgement. Deducts XP from the task\'s own pillars and adds a smaller honesty bonus to Character — self-reporting is what earns the bonus. Works for regular tasks, habits and routine steps (they\'re all tasks). A missed task stays missed and can\'t be completed later.' On success: ok(await withMode(db, now, { ...res })). On failure: toolError(...).

Register mark_event_missed tool: inputSchema = {event_id: z.uuid(), reason: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300)}. Description: 'Mark an event as missed — the user didn\'t attend and is being honest. Same penalty + honesty bonus flow as mark_missed. Different from cancelling (update_event action=cancel: no penalty) and from complete_event not_at_it=true (that\'s leaving deliberately, no penalty). Use this when they didn\'t make it and want to own up.' Same ok/toolError pattern.
Export function registerMissTools(server: McpServer) that registers both tools.
